inputs.text: [excited] Brak… ee… oh… SOR… us. [curious] In Greek, "brachio" means arm. And "saurus," [pauses] lizard.
[happily] Exactly. Its front legs [pauses] were longer than its back legs — like two giant arms. It lived in North America, [amazed] a hundred fifty million years ago.
[playful] Was it all alone out there?
[confident] No, in herds. And hunters like Allosaurus [serious] only dared go after the young ones — a full-grown adult was way too tall for that.
